Persijap Jepara, meanwhile, sit 14th–15th with 21 points and remain in a tense battle to avoid dropping closer to the relegation zone.

Home advantage will be crucial for Persik, who have shown they can be difficult to beat in Kediri. Persijap have struggled on the road throughout the season and will need to be extremely disciplined if they want to take anything from this fixture. The match offers Persik a realistic chance to collect three points and build momentum heading into the final stretch of the campaign.

They will likely try to exploit width and create chances from set-pieces or quick transitions. Persijap Jepara, on the other hand, have been vulnerable defensively away from home and often adopt a deep defensive block, hoping to hit on the counter or capitalise on mistakes.

The tactical key will be whether Persik can break down Persijap’s compact shape without leaving too much space behind. Persijap’s best chance lies in staying patient and looking for opportunities from long balls or individual skill up front. With the home crowd behind them, Persik should have the initiative, but they must remain clinical in front of goal.
